risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate risk is explicitly identified as a major risk factor in the 10-K. Changes in interest rates directly affect the net interest margin, the bank's primary revenue source. Exposure depends on the asymmetry of rate sensitivity between interest-bearing assets and liabilities.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: TRST's portfolio of real estate and commercial loans represents the majority of assets. Credit defaults and loan loss provisions constitute a substantial risk to earnings and capital.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operations financing depends on the stability of customer deposits. Any shift in customer withdrawal behavior or confidence crisis could create liquidity pressures.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Chartered bank subject to federal and state supervisory oversight. Capital requirements, liquidity standards, and compliance rules may impose additional burdens.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Like any financial institution, TRST is exposed to litigation and claims risk that could affect its reputation and ability to attract new customers.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in interest rates and real estate collateral values directly affect the loan portfolio value and equity capital position.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: TRST operates in a competitive regional banking market where large national banks and fintech firms provide increased competition on deposit rates and lending terms.

ai_positioning.summary: TRST does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report. Technology references are limited to topics such as cybersecurity and digital banking trends.
